name: Derek Phyn
story: Derek Phyn helped establish geospatial emergency-management practice as a professional community. NEMA records him, then a Waikato Regional Council GIS Analyst, receiving a Silver Ministerial Award for his contribution to GIS in emergency management and leadership in developing NZGIS4EM. His 2018 ISCRAM paper documents the community’s formation and purpose.
